abstract: BACKGROUND: With increased surgeon comfort using laparoscopy, we hypothesized resection of pediatric ovarian dermoids using laparoscopy would yield a shorter length of stay and no increase in morbidity or recurrence compared to laparotomy. METHODS: A retrospective review was performed amongst eleven pediatric hospitals. Patients aged 2 to 21 who underwent resection of an ovarian dermoid from 2010 to 2020 were included. Patient characteristics, operative details, and outcomes by approach were evaluated using Chi-squared and Wilcoxon-Mann tests. RESULTS: 466 patients were included, with a median age of 14.4 and median follow-up of 4.0 months. 279 patients underwent laparoscopy (60%), 139 laparotomy (30%), and 48 laparoscopy converted to laparotomy (10%). There were no differences in rates of tumor spillage by approach (p = 0.15). 65% underwent ovarian-sparing surgery and 35% underwent oophorectomy. Length of stay was significantly shorter amongst patients who underwent laparoscopy (1 day versus 2 days for laparotomy and converted, p<0.0001). There were no differences in rates of suspected recurrence or reoperation (p = 0.19 and p = 0.57, respectively). CONCLUSION: Patients who underwent laparoscopy experienced no differences in the rates of tumor spillage, recurrence, or reoperation and had a shorter length of stay compared to laparotomy. Laparoscopy is an acceptable approach for resection of pediatric ovarian dermoids.
abstract_ja: 背景：外科医が腹腔鏡手術に慣れてきたことを踏まえ、小児卵巣皮様嚢腫の切除を腹腔鏡下で行うと、開腹手術と比べて在院日数が短くなり、合併症や再発が増加しないと仮定した。方法：11の小児病院で後方視的レビューを実施した。2010年から2020年に卵巣皮様嚢腫の切除を受けた2歳から21歳の患者を対象とした。手術アプローチ別の患者特性、手術詳細および転帰を、カイ二乗検定およびWilcoxon-Mann検定を用いて評価した。結果：466例が対象となり、年齢中央値は14.4歳、追跡期間中央値は4.0か月であった。279例(60%)が腹腔鏡手術、139例(30%)が開腹手術、48例(10%)が腹腔鏡から開腹へ移行した。アプローチ別の腫瘍破綻率に差はなかった(p = 0.15)。65%が卵巣温存手術を受け、35%が卵巣摘除術を受けた。在院日数は腹腔鏡手術を受けた患者で有意に短かった(腹腔鏡1日、開腹および移行例2日、p<0.0001)。疑われる再発率または再手術率に差はなかった(それぞれp = 0.19およびp = 0.57)。結論：腹腔鏡手術を受けた患者では、腫瘍破綻、再発、再手術の割合に差はなく、開腹手術と比べて在院日数が短かった。腹腔鏡は小児卵巣皮様嚢腫の切除に許容されるアプローチである。
